about.zh: 整张图放大 1.5 倍轻轻重画，让手变大；再找出每只手，放大重画后贴回去。
about.en: The whole picture is enlarged 1.5× and redrawn lightly, so the hands grow; then each hand is found, redrawn larger and pasted back.

source.zh: 参考作者的「先放大重画」和「手部精修」两步合在一起，2026-10-29 在 RTX 4050 上试出这组数
source.en: The reference author's light redraw after enlarging and his hand detailing, put together; these numbers tried on an RTX 4050 on 2026-10-29

after: The picture is enlarged 1.5× and drawn again lightly (the sampler now takes it, at denoise 0.4), then every hand found is redrawn larger (hands, denoise 0.45) and saved with prefix hands_fixed; the enlarged one is saved too, without the hand pass. About 3 tries in 4 give a good hand: run_workflow with batch 4 (each try its own seed), then check them before the user does: zoom_image each hands_fixed picture on the hand, compare_with the old picture, and drop a hand with the wrong number of fingers, fused or melted fingers, or one far bigger or smaller than its arm. None good: run_workflow batch 4 again, at most twice. Then a picks panel zoomed on the hand lets the user choose among the good ones. A picture over about 1.6 megapixels: lower bigger's scale_by so it ends near 2.4 megapixels.
notes: Tried on the Codex test picture (1280×832, three characters, the hand about 110×78 px): the hand pass alone gave a good hand in about half the seeds whatever its size (512 or 768) and denoise (0.45 or 0.55); enlarging 1.5× first gave good hands in 3 of 4. Denoise 0.4 for the enlarged redraw kept the layout; faces and splashes change a little.

anima.without_loras: On an Anima model the Anima Turbo LoRA (anima-turbo-lora-v0.2, the user can get it in the ways panel) makes this about three times faster: 10 steps at CFG 1.
anima.after: On this Anima model the Anima Turbo LoRA (0.7) makes both passes 10 steps at CFG 1, about 75 s for 1280×832 on a 6 GB card.
